title: Sufficiently divisible twists pull back to powers of the line module
statement: Let $A=\bigoplus_{n\geq0}A_n$ be a nonnegatively graded commutative ring, $Z$ a quasi-compact scheme [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme], $M$ an invertible $\mathcal O_Z$-module [def-sc-invertible-module], and $\psi:A\to\Gamma_*(Z,M)=\bigoplus_{n\geq0}\Gamma(Z,M^{\otimes n})$ a homomorphism of graded rings [def-sc-invertible-section-ring]. Suppose the nonvanishing opens $Z_{\psi(a)}$, for homogeneous $a\in A$ of positive degree, cover $Z$ [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. Let $r:Z\to P=\operatorname{Proj}(A)$ [def-pc-proj] be the canonical morphism, characterized by $r^{-1}D_+(a)=Z_{\psi(a)}$ and the local ring maps $A_{(a)}\to\Gamma(Z_{\psi(a)},\mathcal O_Z)$, $b/a^n\mapsto\psi(b)/\psi(a)^n$ for $b\in A_{n\deg(a)}$. Write $\mathcal O_P(m)=\widetilde{A(m)}$ [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf]. There exists $d\geq1$ such that for every $k\geq1$ there is a canonical isomorphism $r^*\mathcal O_P(dk)\simeq M^{\otimes dk}$ [def-pc-module-pullback] [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product].

proof.text: Use the given preimage formula to regard hcover as a cover by inverse images of positive homogeneous standard opens. Quasi-compactness gives finitely many such opens, indexed by a finite set t with positive degrees n_i. Put d=product_i n_i. The empty product is 1, so d>0 even for an empty scheme. For each k>0 and each retained chart, n_i divides d*k and q_i=d*k/n_i is positive. The homogeneous element a_i^q_i has degree d*k and D_+(a_i^q_i)=D_+(a_i), hence all degree-d*k inverse-image charts cover Z. This is the private proved exists_common_degree_cover; only the standard-open power identity and finite-product arithmetic are used.

proof.text: Fix m=d*k and let U_a=r^{-1}D_+(a) for a in A_m. The section a/1 of O(m), given by unitToTwist, is a free generator on D_+(a); ordinary pullback preserves this generator. The supplied preimage equation and mem_nonvanishingLocus_iff_generatesAt identify U_a with the generating locus of psi(a), so psi(a) freely generates M^m there.

proof.text: For a,b in A_m use c=r^#(a/b) on U_b. map_unitToTwist_eq_smul and pullbackSection_map_eq_smul give r^*(a/1)=c*r^*(b/1), while hr_formula with exponent 1 gives psi(a)=c*psi(b). The private proved exists_iso_of_section_ratios restricts these identities to arbitrary overlap opens. Cancellation against a free generator converts any linear relation between source frames into the same relation between target frames. Apply the proved isoOfIsFreeGenerator to glue the frame maps and their inverses. On each U_b every homogeneous section satisfies the same ratio equation, so the glued isomorphism sends r^*(a/1) to psi(a) for every a, by sheaf separatedness.

proof.text: The section-normalized tensor pullback adjunction and the ordinary pullback adjunction are related by leftAdjointUniq. Its unit compatibility, evaluated on sections in the private proved tensorPullbackSection_transport, sends the actual tensorPullbackSection 1 tensor a to ordinary pullbackSection a. Compose this object isomorphism with the frame-glued isomorphism. The normalization just proved becomes exactly the required tensor-pullback section equality; restriction from top is the identity. All three private helpers are fully proved, and no canonical map existence theorem is needed because r and its chart formulas are hypotheses.

mathlib_searches.query: Given a graded ring homomorphism A to the section ring of an invertible sheaf L, on a quasi compact generation locus the canonical morphism to Proj pulls back O(d) isomorphically to L tensor d for sufficiently divisible d
Canonical morphism to Proj associated to graded sections of a line bundle pulls back a sufficiently divisible twist to the tensor power of that line bundle
Graded algebra map to tensor powers of a line bundle identifies the pullback of a positive twist on Proj with a positive power of the line bundle

lean.statement: theorem exists_proj_canonical_map_twist_comparison {A : Type u} [CommRing A] (𝒜 : ℕ → AddSubgroup A) [GradedRing 𝒜] (Z : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace Z] (M : Z.Modules) [M.IsInvertible] (ψ : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ sectionRingGrade M) (hcover : ∀ z : Z, ∃ (n : ℕ) (a : A) (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 n), 0 < n ∧ z ∈ nonvanishingLocus (M.tensorPow n) ((gradedSectionElement 𝒜 M ψ a ha).val n)) (r : Z ⟶ Proj 𝒜) (hr_preimage : ∀ (d : ℕ) (_hd : 0 < d) (a : A) (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 d), (r ⁻¹ᵁ Proj.basicOpen 𝒜 a : Set Z) = nonvanishingLocus (M.tensorPow d) ((gradedSectionElement 𝒜 M ψ a ha).val d)) (hr_formula : ∀ (d : ℕ) (_hd : 0 < d) (a : A) (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 d), ∀ (n : ℕ) (b : A) (hb : b ∈ 𝒜 (n • d)), (r.app (Proj.basicOpen 𝒜 a) (Proj.awayToSection 𝒜 a (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk 𝒜 ha n b hb))) • (M.tensorPow (n • d)).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : r ⁻¹ᵁ Proj.basicOpen 𝒜 a ≤ ⊤)).op (((gradedSectionElement 𝒜 M ψ a ha).val ^ n) (n • d)) = (M.tensorPow (n • d)).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : r ⁻¹ᵁ Proj.basicOpen 𝒜 a ≤ ⊤)).op ((gradedSectionElement 𝒜 M ψ b hb).val (n • d))) : ∃ d : ℕ, 0 < d ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, 0 < k → ∃ θ : ((tensorPullback r).obj (Proj.twist 𝒜 (0 + ((d * k : ℕ) : ℤ))) ≅ M.tensorPow (d * k)), ∀ (a : A) (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 (d * k)), θ.hom.app (r ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤) (tensorPullbackSection r (Proj.twist 𝒜 (0 + ((d * k : ℕ) : ℤ))) ⊤ ((Proj.unitToTwist (𝒜 := 𝒜) ha).app ⊤ (1 : Γ(Proj 𝒜, ⊤)))) = (M.tensorPow (d * k)).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : r ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤ ≤ ⊤)).op ((gradedSectionElement 𝒜 M ψ a ha).val (d * k))
